title: Tile wave
description: A magenta and yellow print breaks into displaced tiles while its type stays recognizable.
useCase: Kinetic posters, animated image treatments, and graphic transition studies.
interaction: Change warp amount, switch tile density, or pause
reducedMotion: The tile field stays still. Warp and density controls redraw a static composition.
limitations: Canvas 2D source slicing and sine offsets, not cloth physics or a WebGL shader.
look: Hot magenta poster with a yellow panel and heavy magenta sans-serif type, sliced into offset rectangular tiles, with dark magenta control chips along the bottom.
motion: Each frame redraws the print as tiles offset by two slow crossing sine waves, rows shearing sideways and columns bobbing; a warp slider scales offsets and a toggle doubles density.
adapt: `paintArt` draws the source print to an offscreen canvas and `draw` slices it into `cols` × `rows` tiles shifted by sines of `phase`; tune `amount`, the 0.55/0.3 multipliers and the 0.65 speed in `tick`. Replace `paintArt` with your own artwork.
